description: This file defines the MakeFileParser class, which is responsible for parsing make files and extracting key-value data related to build modules within an Android project. It includes methods for reading a make file, processing its content line by line, handling variable substitutions, and providing access to parsed values.

classes.name: MakeFileParser
classes.description: A utility class for parsing make files to extract key-value pairs and handle variable substitutions specific to Android build configurations.

methods.name: MakeFileParser
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a specific make file.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Retrieves the values associated with a given key after parsing.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Reads and processes the make file to populate key-value pairs.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the parser, mainly its parsed values.
